sentences.text: "On 14.09.2023, the parties were directed to appear before the Illaqa Magistrate/trial Court, to get their statements recorded with regard to the compromise, if any.

For the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed and Annexure P-4
is taken on record.

C R M - 5 2 6 0 3 - 2 0 2 3 T h e p r e s e n t a p p l i c a t i o n h a s b e e n f i l e d b y t h e applicants-petitioners for recording the statement of Harjeet Singh @ Happy regarding the compromise through his power of attorney holder Raghvir Singh.
Heard.

For the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed and the parties are directed to get record their statements in terms of the order dated 14.09.2023 with regard to genuineness of compromise before the Trial Court on 25.01.2024."
